The evidence is enough to show how Tshisekedi managed pressure, but not enough to show that he built durable, non-repressive regime strength.","evidence":[{"title":"Coalition formation and a technocratic PM helped stabilize the new government","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-04-01","url":"https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/dr-congo-president-appoints-countrys-first-female-prime-minister-2024-04-01/","summary":"After the disputed inauguration, Tshisekedi used coalition bargaining to install Judith Suminwa, a technocratic planning minister, as prime minister. This is positive evidence that he could preserve governing capacity and reduce post-election uncertainty by adapting his governing coalition rather than relying only on naked coercion.","question_ids":["8B.9","8B.8","4B.2"]},{"title":"Finance and budget staffing leaned technocratic, not purely patronage-based","publisher":"ACP / Ministry of Finance","date":"2024-05-30","url":"https://acp.cd/economie/rdc-fwamba-likunde-un-technocrate-rompu-a-la-tete-du-ministere-des-finances-par-elysee-kakese/","summary":"The finance ministry was given to Doudou Fwamba, described as a career public-finance technocrat. This supports the reading that Tshisekedi sometimes used professional staffing to maintain regime performance and manage institutional resistance.","question_ids":["8B.9","8B.8","6B.5"]},{"title":"Peace diplomacy with Angola and the UN kept the eastern crisis in a managed channel","publisher":"Presidency of RDC / UN","date":"2024-03-25 to 2024-09-24","url":"https://presidence.cd/actualite-detail/actualite/crise_securitaire_dans_lest_de_la_rdc_les_presidents_felix_tshisekedi_et_salva_kiir_appellent_au-respect_des_accords_de_paix","summary":"Tshisekedi repeatedly used the Nairobi/Luanda track, backed the ceasefire, and later discussed ongoing peace efforts with the UN Secretary-General. This is direct evidence that he preserved regime influence internationally by keeping diplomatic channels open rather than abandoning them.","question_ids":["8B.9","8B.7"]},{"title":"External actors still saw him as participating in de-escalatory diplomacy","publisher":"U.S. State Dept. readout via GlobalSecurity","date":"2024-12-27","url":"https://www.globalsecurity.org/military/library/news/2024/12/mil-241227-state01.htm","summary":"The Blinken readout thanked Tshisekedi for his commitment to the Luanda process and willingness to talk. That is useful independent evidence that his diplomacy was not merely performative and that he retained some external leverage.","question_ids":["8B.9"]},{"title":"The peace track did not produce a durable settlement by year-end","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-12-15","url":"https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/congo-and-rwanda-say-peace-talks-in-angola-will-not-take-place-2024-12-15/","summary":"The Angola summit collapsed after deadlock over direct DRC-M23 dialogue, and Reuters said hopes for a deal were dashed. This is strong counterevidence: Tshisekedi kept the channel open, but he did not convert it into a durable outcome in 2024.","question_ids":["8B.9","8B.7"]},{"title":"He relied on militarized control and proxy forces, which managed pressure but exposed weakness","publisher":"Reuters / Straits Times / presidency","date":"2024-02-23 to 2024-07-17","url":"https://www.straitstimes.com/world/army-disarray-hobbles-congos-fight-with-rwanda-backed-rebels-officers-say","summary":"Reuters reported army disarray, overlapping command chains, and heavy reliance on Wazalendo proxies that the army did not control; Tshisekedi had instructed that they be brought in line. This suggests partial management of a dangerous security coalition, but also that regime control was fragile and improvised.","question_ids":["8B.9","8B.8","1B.9"]},{"title":"Repression of journalists, activists, and opposition members undercut political durability","publisher":"Amnesty International / Human Rights Watch / Reuters","date":"2024-02-16 to 2024-05-03","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/05/media-freedom-under-threat/","summary":"Amnesty and HRW described arbitrary detention, judicial harassment, media closures, and police violence against peaceful protest. This is strong negative evidence for regime management: short-term control was being bought through repression, but at the cost of deeper legitimacy and trust.","question_ids":["8B.9","7B.9","4B.1"]},{"title":"Constitutional reform toward a third term was a self-entrenchment signal","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-10-24","url":"https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/congo-president-tshisekedi-draws-criticism-over-constitutional-reform-plans-2024-10-24/","summary":"Reuters reported a commission to study constitutional revisions that could remove term limits and enable a third term. Regardless of the stated rationale, this is the clearest evidence that Tshisekedi’s 2024 political strategy included regime preservation through possible entrenchment.","question_ids":["8B.9","4B.1"]},{"title":"Oversight bodies were selectively empowered, but the system remained weak","publisher":"Presidency of RDC / IMF / World Bank","date":"2024-07-03 to 2024-11-15","url":"https://www.presidence.cd/actualite-detail/actualite/le_chef_de_l_etat_a_assiste_a_louverture_de_la_session_extraordinaire_du_conseil_superieur_de_la_cour_des_comptes","summary":"Tshisekedi backed the Court of Accounts, and IMF-backed reforms pushed treasury controls, spending-chain discipline, and revenue mobilization. This is the clearest positive evidence that he could absorb institutional resistance and use it to reinforce regime capacity, though the implementation picture remained uneven.","question_ids":["8B.9","8B.8","6B.6"]}]}
